with the following prayers :-

It is further prayed

sentences.text: that this Hon'ble Court may also be pleased to stay the impugned order dated 21.11.2022 and 06.12.2022 including the entire proceedings of the Case No. 853 of 2019 (State vs. Satendra Kumar), in Case Crime No. 103 of 2017, under Sections 498A/323/504/506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Binjore, in terms of settlement/agreement/compromise deed dated 05.12.2022, pending in the court of Civil Judge(J.D.)/FTC-2, Bijnor, otherwise the applicant shall suffer an irreparable loss and injury."
This is the second application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for the same relief.

The first 482 Cr.P.C.
application being Application U/S 482 No. 22863 of 2019 (Satendra Kumar vs. State of U.P. and another) was referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court vide order dated 21.6.2019 passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court, copy of the said order is annexure no. 8 to the affidavit (page no. 63-64 of the paper book).

entities.text: Satendra Kumar vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Court is of the opinion that if there was subsequent developments, the applicant would have supplemented the same in the first petition and brought the copy of the same in the said file.
The present application is thus totally an abuse of process of court and is dismissed as such.

Learned counsel for the applicants, at this stage, after arguing at some length states that the present application be dismissed as withdrawn as learned counsel for the State has pointed out that first 482 Cr.P.C. application of the applicant being Application U/S 482 No. 22863 of 2019 for quashing of the proceedings is still pending before this Court.
The application is dismissed as withdrawn.
